title: PingServerCommand
description: Connection and command-path probe. The client sends it; the server answers with PING_REPLY carrying the same command_id and probe_seq. It changes no game state. p0-01 proves the contract pipeline with it; the p0-02 WebSocket spike uses it to measure the command round trip.

probe_seq.description: Client-chosen probe counter (u32) used to match the reply and compute round-trip time on the client clock.
